caseNameFull: Bowsher, Comptroller General of the United States v. Synar, Member of Congress United States Senate v. Synar, Member of Congress and O'Neill, Speaker of the United States House of Representatives v. Synar, Member of Congress

opinions.text: Appeals from D. C. D. C. Probable jurisdiction noted, cases consolidated, and a total .of one hour allotted each side for oral argument. Motion of the parties to dispense temporarily with printing and to set an expedited briefing schedule and argument date granted. Reported below: 626 F. Supp. 1374.
